title: Taking Picture Mechanic in RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: Zhyren
posts.body:
I don't know if this is even possible but I want to create a game mechanic in which you can take a picture of the screen and then save it to a photo album. Throughout the game the pictures taken would pop up throughout a "dream sequence". I think I already know how I'll establish putting images into a photo album by assigning individual variables to the photos, but what I'm having trouble with is whether or not my idea is even plausible.
The main question here is if I can take in game screenshots or other forms of screen capture and have them be saved and assigned a variable, making them individual to every playthrough in a way.
If this isn't possible, I'd love to hear some alternative ideas for how I should go about this! I'm new to RPGMaker and don't know much of its limitations but I've been learning a lot! Thank you for reading.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Zhyren said:
The main question here is if I can take in game screenshots or other forms of screen capture and have them be saved and assigned a variable, making them individual to every playthrough in a way.
Click to expand...
This gets a data URL (i.e. file-independent string representation) of a snapshot texture:
JavaScript:
SceneManager.snap()._canvas.toDataURL()
Since it's a string, there are no problems including it in save data. Note that it will generally be quite a
long
string, so be aware of possible save bloat issues.
You'll need an actual display object instance, like a
Sprite
, to show it in-game. E.g.
JavaScript:
sprite.bitmap = Bitmap.load(dataURL);
(I've used a similar approach in feature Q36 of my plugin
Cae_Tweaks
- "Show Picture snapshots".)
